description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Darius''' attempts to execute the target enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|leaping]] towards them to deal [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's [[File:Hemorrhage.png|20px]] Hemorrhage stacks), and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area around them for 2.5 seconds from the start of the cast time.
description.text: Active: Darius attempts to execute the target enemy champion, leaping towards them to deal  true damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's Hemorrhage stacks), and granting sight of the area around them for 2.5 seconds from the start of the cast time.

description2.raw: If the target dies within 0.15 seconds after being hit by ''Noxian Guillotine'', '''Darius''' [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|fears]] nearby [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by up to 99% over the duration. He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.
description2.text: If the target dies within 0.15 seconds after being hit by Noxian Guillotine, Darius fears nearby minions and monsters for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually slowed by up to 99% over the duration. He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.

description3.raw: At rank 3, ''Noxian Guillotine'' has no [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost and recast timer.
description3.text: At rank 3, Noxian Guillotine has no  mana cost and recast timer.

description4.raw: '''''Darius''' is unable to cast [[File:Darius Decimate.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Decimate|An icon for Darius's ability Decimate]] [[Darius#Decimate|Decimate]] or [[File:Darius Apprehend.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Apprehend|An icon for Darius's ability Apprehend]] [[Darius#Apprehend|Apprehend]] for 0.25 seconds after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.''
description4.text: Darius is unable to cast Decimate or Apprehend for 0.25 seconds after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.

notes.text:
Noxian Guillotine's cooldown after the recast or recast window is calculated by taking the values at the end, and using this formula: (Noxian Guillotine's Cooldown - time since first cast) × 100 ÷ (100 +  AH).
Noxian Guillotine applies Hemorrhage after the damage.
Darius will only leap towards the target if it is at range, or leap backwards if it is very close.
* This leap can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, Darius will still hit the target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jE6vb4IqvC8]
* The ability is disabled while grounded or rooted even if Darius is in the range in which he does not leap.
Noxian Guillotine will not reset nor trigger Noxian Might if used to kill a clone or a target protected by resurrection.
Noxian Guillotine will reset but not trigger Noxian Might if it finishes off a target that is in a zombie state.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
